reviews.text: This game is the future of vr competitive leagues. So much fun and so worth the price. Highly recommend this game to anyone with a vr!

Was able to play test this game though to release, but sadly can not play it for too long as its a high motion game and I get motion sick very easily. It is a fun game if your mind and stomach can handle it.

No game incorporates the freedoms of Vr controls as well as Starvault. Each of the (currently 16) new heroes in the game have an incredibly unique feel and playstyle to them that no other Vr game I’ve played has been able to capture. Whether you’d rather tank for your team as a giant mech with heavy artillery or flank your enemies as an invisible assassin with a lightsaber, the game has something worth trying. On the topic of actual gameplay: Starvault has done an excellent job of making a MOBA that works in vr. It plays similarly to deadlock in many ways with aspects reminiscent of team based hero shooters. And the best part of the game is the community. From community ran tournaments hosted via discord and offering 5,000$ prize pools funded by the devs (the next one is starting soon!) to the devs pushing updates every two weeks, new heroes every month and a half, and being so responsive that bug reports are never unanswered longer than a day. I cannot recommend this game enough.

THIS, is why you own a VR headset! The immersion factor is off the charts. The weapons feel weighty and impactful. The character models look like alien SUPERHEROES. 13 different characters to choose from - many different play/weapon styles. The movement is smooth and fluid. You can fly, crawl, jump,, dash, run, sprint, (yes, there are 3 characters that even use gorilla tag arm movement) Amazing community - not toxic. The developers understand the strengths of VR and have executed a masterpiece. Don't let the low price fool you, this game punches above it's weight in every measure.

Best VR moba. Would like better skins. Just color variations aren't enough for me to spend money on. I'd prefer skins that really change the look. Gameplay is solid and pretty balanced although sometimes there's multiple of the same hero. Not sure how that happens overall just as solid as it was on quest. PC could use some enhancements for graphics like more detail would be nice

[h1]Experienced on the Meta Quest 3[/h1] I do recommend this game. I had fun. I only played about 2 hours and I seem to have just scratched the surface of everything this game has to offer. There's so many heroes and they all play differently. This game does remind me a lot of Overwatch. You have a Winston-like character tank that uses a Gorilla tag style movement. You have a Lucio type character that uses a hoverboard to move around the map and that can heal. There's so many characters though and I did try them all and they all seemed fun and different. Not just different weapons, but different special abilities and different movement styles. As far as the day of launch, there seemed to be a healthy amount of players online for a VR title. However, I have no idea how many people were online or if this game will still have an online community a month from now. All I can say is that I had fun and I hope this game grows and that VR players adopt this game. It's super cheap right now at 40% off the normal price. If you're into online PVP / co-op type games then I think you'll enjoy this one. It's one of the better made ones in VR IMO. You can watch my VR live gameplay here: https://youtube.com/live/8TqUPMaifHM [b]Rate ?/10. Haven't played it enough to even guess at a score. There's a lot here to take in.[/b] [quote]Please note: I received a free Steam key through the Steam Curator Connect program. If you enjoyed my review, please consider joining my Steam Curator group [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/Oculus_WMR]Oculus Rift Reviews.[/url][/quote]

Personally, I like it. I didn't expect much and yet this game managed to surprise me. I like the look of it even if it's low poly. I like the lighting effects, much better than the quest version, and it runs smoothly on my system. There are a lot of heroes to choose and they seem all different. Some are quite difficult to master. However they all have strenght and weaknesses. I think the devs did a good job on average to balance them all, although I found that some characters are overpowered or some are too weak. Also, there appears to be only one map at the moment. The game mode itself is quite simple and yet interesting. If you play this strategically is quite fun.
A MOBA where all the characters I have played so far have combat abilities that feel pretty unique! I haven't got the ability to try them all, but will update.

Finally a moba that I can play better than anyone in my friend group! Player be warned: The pc version has some jank. Use the discord and the devs will absolutely help you like they helped me. Game is awesome. Kids are playing but you can mute them. Discord is active. The price covers 3 months of Battle Pass and unlocks all characters immediately so a good value. The graphics honestly don't look much better than the native quest version but my headset lasts longer and I don't need to record because everything is saved and usable in the pc spectator app. Overall 10/10

I've got ~100 hours on quest 3 version. Best MOBA/ Hero shooter in VR to date. Frequent updates, lots of variety of play styles, and competitive. Recommended if you like DOTA/ League of legends, and VR gaming.

this game is awesome I love MOBAs and this mixes VR elements with a MOBA in a very fluid way really a good time
there are just a few characters with quite weird design but it makes up for immersive gameplay, just wish there was a voice chat with enemy team as well

I saw MOBA and VR in the same sentence and had the lowest of expectations. This game actually slaps low-key. Definitely could use some more polish, but the foundation is there and it feels pretty damn good to play when you aren't teamed up with toddlers. My only complaint is the mute button is hidden better than Anne Frank.

好玩，非常棒，是多端匹配，不用担心没人玩，瞬间就能匹配上。需要加速器，有的加速器可能没效果，我这边用的qiyou加速器，你也可以去找你的加速器客服反馈。延迟我感觉还行，应该在50-80之间，能玩。中文程度还行，虽然不是完全中文但不影响玩，比较大的问题是玩家玩的红方，看队友也是红的，不会红蓝切换，我已经因为这个问题误杀好多次队友了，因为我那个大招是对任何人都有伤害，包括我自己。I hope the official can make a small adjustment to the game. When I switch factions and join the red team, my teammates still show up as red to me. I’ve accidentally killed my teammates many times because of this. Could this be fixed? After I join the red team, I want my teammates to display as blue instead.

I was skeptical of a vr moba, but I just put 2.5 hours in the tutorial alone. Idk if the pvp or pve is any good yet because my headset died before getting there, but the tutorial alone makes it worth a pickup.

Amazing game, the perfect combination of MOBA and VR, there's literally nothing like this and it really scratches this league of legends itch. The polish is amazing because it's been released in standalone VR for over a year, which also means optimization is very very good. Character variety is where it lacks in my opinion but I can see why. Every character feels unique, but not just in their kit, role, and abilities, there are characters that don't even walk, there's a done that can fly, a dual wielding pistol shooter that glides on a hoverboard by tilting your body, a spider that can stick to walls, a ninja that can do directional flips mid air as a second jump, a drone that literally flies with no limit, a gorilla that has to use his arms to walk (Which is exhausting but so damn fun). I just appreciate the love that the devs have put into this amazing game, and I will continue to play it and support it, now on PC with better graphics, for a long time!

This game is truly special. Can't recommend enough. Actual peak immersion. Controls are so well thought out. You can tell the team really loves VR and is actually challenging the medium. This game makes me excited about the future of VR.
Great use of 6 DoF and VR native mechanics to make each character playstyle more unique than you could if playing a flatscreen MOBA.
Played a little on headset before steam and it was fun. This is insanely worth it and you get free battlepasses dur to buying the game :D

I never expected MOBA mechanics to work this well in VR. Pushing lanes, fighting for objectives, and landing abilities by hand makes every match feel far more intense than expected. Fun and playful.

The mix of hero shooter action and classic MOBA strategy feels surprisingly natural. Team fights are chaotic in the best way and every match creates memorable moments worth chasing. Amazing experience
VR and MOBA sounded like a strange combination at first. After a few matches, it feels like a genre pairing that should have happened years ago because it works so well. Stuck for a long time.
There is something incredibly satisfying about landing the perfect ability in VR and watching a team fight swing in your favor. Moments like that keep bringing me back and start a new match.
Не думал, что MOBA в VR может работать настолько хорошо и так затягивать. Когда сам целишься способностями, защищаешь линию и участвуешь в командных драках, эмоций становится в разы больше и ярче.
Не ожидал настолько сильного ощущения присутствия в VR. Когда команда идет на решающий штурм, ты не наблюдатель со стороны, а полноценный участник событий, от которого реально что-то зависит.

Starvault expertly combines MOBA mechanics with immersive VR action. The character diversity keeps matches engaging, and the community is remarkably friendly. Highly recommended.
The immersive nature of Starvault makes it stand out among VR titles. Each hero brings unique abilities that transform battles. The strategic depth adds to its replay value.
The strongest feature is how differently heroes move: flying, wall-crawling, arm-swinging, gliding, and flipping all feel designed for VR. Matches are tactical, polished, and easy to lose hours in.
